prompt:
High-fidelity desktop web UI design comp, landscape, for the organizer dashboard of a retreat-planning survey product. This is a designed interface screen, not a poster: it must read as a screenshot of a working admin product.

Layout scaffold: the availability heatmap IS the page — it owns almost the whole viewport, on a solid warm near-black background (#0b0908, no photograph). Top edge: one thin masthead row with a small uppercase tracked label "THE ATMOSPHERIC BUILDERS' RETREAT — ORGANIZER" on the left, a quiet "Closes Aug 15" center-right, and a fully rounded white pill button with black text "Export CSV" far right, separated from the rest by a 1px white hairline. Main region filling roughly 70% of the viewport: a giant calendar availability heatmap headed by an oversized ultra-condensed tall white grotesque headline "WHEN CAN THEY COME." in capitals; three large month grids side by side labeled SEPTEMBER, OCTOBER, NOVEMBER with generous cell size; each day is a rounded square filled white at an opacity proportional to how many of the 37 respondents are available — near-solid white cells cluster in mid October, faint cells at the edges; small day numerals sit inside cells, dark numerals on bright cells, white on faint ones; several edge cells are split horizontally into a bright top half and a faint bottom half showing half-day arrivals and departures. Along the bottom of the viewport: a full-width hairline ledger strip mixing stats and verdicts in small tracked uppercase — "37 RESPONSES · 24 YES · 11 NEED TRAVEL HELP", then "BEST WINDOW  THU OCT 8 – SUN OCT 11 · 29 OF 33 AVAILABLE", then "TOP PLACE  PALM SPRINGS" — with the very top sliver of a responses table (avatar circles, handles like @maren.dev) just visible below the strip, cut off by the page bottom implying scroll.

Every interface element is pure white at varying opacity on the near-black ground; no second UI color, no cards, no boxes, no shadows; thin 1px hairline rules structure everything; subtle film grain overall; flat matte finish, no gloss, no 3D. No browser chrome.
